# Non-loopback listeners a fresh Margine install is expected to have,
# "proto port", one per line. Anything else listening on a non-loopback
# address fails the security smoke probe. Each line needs a reason.
#
# systemd-resolved LLMNR (Fedora default; see docs/SECURITY.md register)
tcp 5355
udp 5355
# avahi-daemon mDNS (printer and device discovery)
udp 5353
# GSConnect (KDE Connect protocol), enabled by default by the base, listens
# for phones on every interface even when nothing is paired.
# Pending decision D5 in docs/SECURITY-CLAIMS.md.
tcp 1716
udp 1716
# tailscaled, enabled by default by the base. Pending decision D4.
